_comment: Reviewed artifact and curation table for the thirteen isolated first-party build/test
Python components (2026-10-16 first-party curation). sha256 is the SHA-256 of the
deterministic uncompressed tar (fixed PAX format, sorted members, mtime 0, uid/gid 0,
empty uname/gname) built from the exact checked-out file bytes at review time (frozen
CRLF per .gitattributes), so the value matches the future CI checkout. start_lines is the
exact reviewed line set (CSV when several lines share one expression); every entry is a
license reference or a test example literal in first-party MIT tooling, never a grant.
The configuration in .ort/package-configurations/<name>.yml quotes this table verbatim,
bound to the same content-addressed version. expected_concluded_license is the single
reviewed conclusion each curation reaches, owned here so no first-party test source
